changes.title: Rune ranks
items: With ?sigils=new, each rune stone glows in the rank colour of the strongest animal living in its area: yellow where a legend lives, red for an adult, purple for a youth, turquoise for babies

changes.title: Stack sharp
items: The sigil stack over your hat stays sharp however tall it grows: the miniature blur at the top of the screen no longer smears it

changes.title: Ladder load rungs
items: Automatic quality's last steps: on a slow graphics card, the next island loads with fewer trees and, last of all, chunkier pixels
